variables.hierarchyHint: Variables resolve from this resource up through its parents. Inherited scopes are shown read-only; locked values are computed by the platform.
variables.orgHint: Variables at the root of the scope chain (referenced as $o.name in scripts), inherited by every workspace, project, and service. Any member who can edit a probe can use them — secrets included, masked or not — so add organization-wide credentials with care.
variables.lockedVariable: Locked — computed by the platform, read-only
variables.typeSecretHelp: Encrypted at rest. Value is never shown after saving.
variables.typeVariableHelp: Encrypted at rest. Value can be revealed on demand.
variables.typeMetricHelp: Stored as plaintext. Always visible. Writable by Lace scripts.
variables.secretExposureNotice: Tracedown never shows a secret again after saving, but it can't stop the endpoint you probe from doing so. If a monitored endpoint reflects this value back in its response (an echo, an error message, a debug field), it may surface in that service's results. Only use secrets against endpoints you trust not to echo them.
